messages.content:
You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  property_types: columns=[id, name, description, created_at, updated_at]
  neighborhoods: columns=[id, name, city, state, country, zip_code, description, walk_score, transit_score, avg_household_income, created_at, updated_at]
  amenities: columns=[id, name, category, icon_url, created_at, updated_at]
  agencies: columns=[id, name, license_number, email, phone, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, zip_code, country, website_url, founded_date, is_active, created_at]
  agents: columns=[id, agency_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, license_number, license_expiry_date, specialization, commission_rate, bio, profile_image_url, is_active, hire_date, created_at], fks=[agency_id→agencies]
  owners: columns=[id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, national_id, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, zip_code, country, owner_type, company_name]
  tenants: columns=[id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, national_id, current_address_line1, current_address_line2, current_city, current_state, current_zip_code, employment_status, employer_name, annual_income]
  properties: columns=[id, property_type_id, neighborhood_id, owner_id, title, description, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, zip_code, country, latitude, longitude, year_built], fks=[property_type_id→property_types, neighborhood_id→neighborhoods, owner_id→owners]
  property_features: columns=[id, property_id, feature_name, feature_value, feature_category, created_at, updated_at], fks=[property_id→properties]
  property_images: columns=[id, property_id, image_url, caption, is_primary, display_order, uploaded_at], fks=[property_id→properties]
  property_amenities: columns=[id, property_id, amenity_id, notes], fks=[property_id→properties, amenity_id→amenities]
  listings: columns=[id, property_id, agent_id, listing_type, listing_status, asking_price, price_per_sqft, available_from, available_until, description, is_featured, views_count, days_on_market, mls_number, created_at], fks=[property_id→properties, agent_id→agents]
  viewings: columns=[id, listing_id, tenant_id, agent_id, scheduled_at, duration_minutes, viewing_status, feedback, interest_level, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[listing_id→listings, tenant_id→tenants, agent_id→agents]
  offers: columns=[id, listing_id, tenant_id, agent_id, offer_amount, deposit_amount, offer_status, offer_date, expiry_date, conditions, counter_offer_amount, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[listing_id→listings, tenant_id→tenants, agent_id→agents]
  contracts: columns=[id, offer_id, property_id, agent_id, contract_type, contract_status, sale_price, closing_date, signed_date, terms_and_conditions, document_url, created_at, updated_at], fks=[offer_id→offers, property_id→properties, agent_id→agents]
  leases: columns=[id, property_id, tenant_id, contract_id, agent_id, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, monthly_rent, security_deposit, pet_deposit, lease_status, rent_due_day, late_fee_amount, late_fee_grace_days, pets_allowed], fks=[property_id→properties, tenant_id→tenants, contract_id→contracts, agent_id→agents]
  lease_payments: columns=[id, lease_id, payment_date, due_date, amount_due, amount_paid, late_fee_applied, payment_method, payment_status, transaction_reference, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[lease_id→leases]
  maintenance_requests: columns=[id, property_id, tenant_id, title, description, category, priority, request_status, reported_at, resolved_at, estimated_cost, actual_cost, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[property_id→properties, tenant_id→tenants]
  maintenance_tasks: columns=[id, maintenance_request_id, assigned_to, task_description, task_status, scheduled_date, completed_date, labor_cost, material_cost, vendor_name, vendor_contact, invoice_url, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[maintenance_request_id→maintenance_requests]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['property_types', 'neighborhoods', 'amenities', 'agencies', 'agents', 'owners', 'tenants', 'properties', 'property_features', 'property_images', 'property_amenities', 'listings', 'viewings', 'offers', 'contracts', 'leases', 'lease_payments', 'maintenance_requests', 'maintenance_tasks']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: real_estate / property_management
  Metrics:  total_rental_revenue, avg_days_on_market, maintenance_cost_per_property, lease_renewal_rate, offer_conversion_rate, late_payment_rate
  Goals:    rental_income_analysis, property_performance_tracking, maintenance_cost_optimization, tenant_lifecycle_analysis
  Grain:    transaction

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  property_types: reference
  neighborhoods: dimension
  amenities: reference
  agencies: dimension
  agents: dimension
  owners: dimension
  tenants: dimension
  properties: dimension
  property_features: dimension
  property_images: dimension
  property_amenities: bridge
  listings: fact
  viewings: fact
  offers: fact
  contracts: fact
  leases: fact
  lease_payments: fact
  maintenance_requests: fact
  maintenance_tasks: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  listings: asking_price, price_per_sqft, views_count, days_on_market
  offers: offer_amount, deposit_amount, counter_offer_amount
  contracts: sale_price
  leases: monthly_rent, security_deposit, pet_deposit, late_fee_amount, late_fee_grace_days
  lease_payments: amount_due, amount_paid, late_fee_applied
  maintenance_requests: estimated_cost, actual_cost
  maintenance_tasks: labor_cost, material_cost
